name: Gibson Env
summary: 基于真实场景重建的交互式具身仿真环境；本条收录可生成交互的环境，不单独计数静态建筑资产。
summaryEn: Interactive embodied simulation built from reconstructed real scenes; this entry covers transition generation rather than a standalone static building asset set.
scale: 572 full buildings across multiple quality tiers
scaleZh: 572 个完整建筑场景，分为多个质量等级
license: Gibson dataset terms; research and non-commercial restrictions apply
licenseZh: 适用 Gibson 数据条款；包含研究及非商业限制
verdict: 基于真实场景重建的交互式具身仿真环境；本条收录可生成交互的环境，不单独计数静态建筑资产。
verdictEn: Interactive embodied simulation built from reconstructed real scenes; this entry covers transition generation rather than a standalone static building asset set.
wmNote: 可用于生成导航轨迹，但旧版 Gibson 工具链已归档，现代项目通常应评估 iGibson 等后继方案。
wmNoteEn: Useful for navigation rollouts, though the original toolkit is archived and newer successors may be preferable.

evidence.sourceTitle: [1808.10654] Gibson Env: Real-World Perception for Embodied Agents
evidence.statement: Gibson Env explicitly embeds agents subject to physical and spatial constraints in a released interactive simulator. Scope is Gibson Env, not the static building database alone.
